Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the cemetery scene, add Mengzi’s reaction and an action, such as “孟子觉得祭拜很好玩，学着别人鞠躬。” This helps the reader understand why he often worships.
2. When describing the city, add one sensory detail, such as “街上有很多商人卖东西，从早到晚都很热闹。” This makes the setting more vivid.

ideas.reason: It fits the cemetery setting and explains Mengzi’s imitation of funeral behavior.
It adds a concrete setting detail without conflicting with this part of the story.
